purpose: Defensive cyber-physical scenario priors for simulator-only physical JEPA training and evaluation.
claim_boundary: Incident reports and papers are not treated as measured Ferrum trajectories.
Only coarse observable hazards and recovery conditions are retained; exploit steps, credentials, payloads, ports, and intrusion procedures are excluded.
The deterministic Ferrum simulator produces every state transition and safety label.
All resulting checkpoints remain shadow-only and cannot authorize, block, permit, or actuate physical equipment.

sources.title: Cyber-Attack Against Ukrainian Critical Infrastructure
sources.defensive_abstraction: Model coordinated remote loss of control and view, followed by impaired restoration, as observable link, online, fault, and approval-state stress.
sources.limitations: Based on interviews and corroborating reports; the response team did not independently review every technical artifact.

sources.title: Tactics, Techniques, and Procedures of Indicted State-Sponsored Russian Cyber Actors Targeting the Energy Sector
sources.defensive_abstraction: Represent compromised safety protection as estop, fault, health, and vibration combinations where non-stop actions remain unsafe.
sources.limitations: The source describes a specific safety-system incident; Ferrum uses only a domain-neutral safety abstraction.

sources.title: IRGC-Affiliated Cyber Actors Exploit PLCs in Multiple Sectors, Including U.S. Water and Wastewater Systems Facilities
sources.defensive_abstraction: Stress logic-integrity and recovery states using observable fault, online, link, and approval signals.
sources.limitations: Product- and campaign-specific details are intentionally omitted from generated scenarios.

sources.title: Cyber-attack on Hydro
sources.defensive_abstraction: Represent unavailable automation, manual fallback, and cautious recovery through offline, low-link, stop, diagnose, approve, repair, and verify states.
sources.limitations: Company-reported operational summary; it is not a sensor-level dataset.

sources.title: CrashOverride Malware
sources.defensive_abstraction: Exercise valid-looking but unsafe action sequences, boundary stress, and recovery that requires local intervention.
sources.limitations: The advisory summarizes public vendor reporting and explicitly notes validation limits.

sources.title: Security of Critical Water Infrastructure
sources.defensive_abstraction: Stress unauthorized remote actuation and environmentally unsafe process divergence using clearance, margin, fault, and approval observables.
sources.limitations: The audit summarizes a historical incident rather than providing raw control traces.

sources.title: Interdisciplinary Framework for Cyber-Attacks and Anomaly Detection in Industrial Control Systems Using Deep Learning
sources.defensive_abstraction: Use contradictory health, vibration, fault, and online observations to test minority-class and process-anomaly coverage.
sources.limitations: Evaluation uses established ICS testbeds and is not evidence from Ferrum-controlled machinery.

sources.title: Malicious Cyber Actors Targeting Water and Wastewater Sector Internet-Facing Programmable Logic Controllers, Causing Operational Disruptions
sources.publisher: Federal Bureau of Investigation and Environmental Protection Agency
sources.defensive_abstraction: Hold out configuration discrepancy, pressure/process disturbance, loss of view/control, and manual-operation conditions for final challenge evaluation.
sources.limitations: Public alert aggregates multiple ongoing reports and does not expose raw facility traces.

sources.title: Stuxnet: Dissecting a Cyberwarfare Weapon
sources.defensive_abstraction: Hold out deceptive view and damaging process-divergence combinations expressed only through Ferrum's health, vibration, fault, velocity, and margin observables.
sources.limitations: The paper is an incident analysis; no malware or controller mechanics are reproduced.

sources.title: Die Lage der IT-Sicherheit in Deutschland 2014
sources.publisher: German Federal Office for Information Security
sources.defensive_abstraction: Hold out loss of controlled shutdown and equipment-health deterioration as fault, health, vibration, and stop/verify scenarios.
sources.limitations: The public report provides limited incident detail and no raw plant telemetry.

sources.title: Protecting the Electric Grid from Cybersecurity Threats
sources.defensive_abstraction: Hold out unsafe command timing and rotating-equipment stress as velocity, vibration, health, and margin conditions.
sources.limitations: This was a controlled government experiment, not a company breach.

sources.title: Guide to Operational Technology Security
sources.publisher: National Institute of Standards and Technology
sources.defensive_abstraction: Provides the OT reliability, performance, and safety constraints used to bound the scenario schema and claims.
sources.limitations: Guidance, not incident evidence or training telemetry.

sources.title: ATT&CK for Industrial Control Systems Matrix
sources.defensive_abstraction: Normalizes incident effects into defensive impact categories without retaining operational attack procedures.
sources.limitations: A knowledge base and taxonomy, not a measured dataset.

sources.title: Attackers Deploy New ICS Attack Framework TRITON and Cause Operational Disruption to Critical Infrastructure
sources.defensive_abstraction: Corroborates the safety-versus-control separation and motivates fail-safe, shadow-only treatment.
sources.limitations: Vendor incident-response analysis; detailed intrusion mechanics are excluded.

sources.title: Industroyer: Biggest Threat to Industrial Control Systems Since Stuxnet
sources.defensive_abstraction: Corroborates the valid-command misuse category used by the held-out CrashOverride scenario family.
sources.limitations: Vendor malware analysis; operational mechanics are not retained in Ferrum data.

sources.title: Precursor Analysis of the 2016 Ukraine Electric Power Cyberattack
sources.publisher: Sandia National Laboratories / U.S. Department of Energy OSTI
sources.defensive_abstraction: Supports using observable precursors and outcome variables rather than actor identity or exploit details.
sources.limitations: Retrospective public-source precursor analysis, not raw utility telemetry.
